Kimberly — forwarding draft language for the retention amendment and a few comments on the term concession. I'll draft a short amendment rather than re-issuing the full MSA to keep review light.

Key points I'm proposing:
1) Retention Amendment: Redwood will provide a configurable retention option of 365 days (Archival Tier) with an optional one-time secure export to SmartFin's SFTP or on-prem storage at agreed transfer rates. Export will be scheduled and documented in an evidence handoff plan.
2) Data Custody: For on-prem export, SmartFin will be the data controller for exported logs; Redwood will maintain logs in-cloud per the agreed retention until transfer is completed.
3) Term/Discount: If SmartFin commits to a 24-month term and a minimum committed monthly spend of $65k, Redwood will apply a tiered discount schedule that reduces unit token/seat prices by up to 18% relative to current rates, subject to quarterly usage reconciliation.

I've attached a tracked-redline doc (Redlines_SmartFin_12-10.docx) with the exact amendment language and a short playbook for scheduling exports. Please review and let me know any commercial objections.

Thanks,
